title: Gaussian integral of an affine monomial
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $a\in\mathbb R^n$, let $s\in\mathbb R$, and let $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ be any subset of coordinates. For $Y$ with the product standard Gaussian law on $\mathbb R^n$, $\mathbb E\left[\prod_{i\in S}(a_i+sY_i)\right]=\prod_{i\in S}a_i$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite subset of the coordinates
